The best thing you can do is encourage her to speak openly with her doctor or midwife about her morning sickness. You might say something like, "I care about you and the baby so much. Have you talked to your doctor about other options for the nausea?" This keeps the door open without sounding judgmental. You're in a hard spot, and reaching out for guidance — even here — shows how much you care.
